schema.text: When choosing how to travel, which factors matter most to you?
schema.help: Mental well-being means how calm or stressed a trip makes you feel.

options.text: Being able to bring children, a pushchair or shopping

en.#When choosing how to travel, which fact: When choosing how to travel, which factors matter most to you?
en.#Mental well-being means how calm or str: Mental well-being means how calm or stressed a trip makes you feel.
en.#Being able to bring children, a pushcha: Being able to bring children, a pushchair or shopping

it.#When choosing how to travel, which fact: Quando scegli come spostarti, quali fattori sono più importanti per te?
it.#Mental well-being means how calm or str: Per benessere mentale si intende quanto uno spostamento ti fa sentire tranquillo/a o stressato/a.
it.#Barrier-free access (no stairs, accessi: Accessibilità senza barriere (niente scale, mezzi accessibili)
it.#Being able to bring children, a pushcha: Poter portare con sé bambini, passeggino o spesa

fr.#When choosing how to travel, which fact: Quand vous choisissez comment vous déplacer, quels facteurs sont les plus importants pour vous ?
fr.#Mental well-being means how calm or str: Le bien-être mental désigne le calme ou le stress que vous ressentez pendant un trajet.
fr.#Barrier-free access (no stairs, accessi: Accès sans obstacles (pas d’escaliers, véhicules accessibles)
fr.#Being able to bring children, a pushcha: Pouvoir emmener des enfants, une poussette ou des courses

de.#When choosing how to travel, which fact: Welche Faktoren sind Ihnen am wichtigsten, wenn Sie entscheiden, wie Sie sich fortbewegen?
de.#Mental well-being means how calm or str: Psychisches Wohlbefinden meint, wie ruhig oder gestresst Sie sich auf einem Weg fühlen.
de.#Being able to bring children, a pushcha: Kinder, Kinderwagen oder Einkäufe mitnehmen können

tr.#When choosing how to travel, which fact: Nasıl seyahat edeceğinize karar verirken hangi faktörler sizin için en önemlidir?
tr.#Mental well-being means how calm or str: Zihinsel iyi oluş, bir yolculuğun sizi ne kadar sakin veya stresli hissettirdiği anlamına gelir.
tr.#Being able to bring children, a pushcha: Çocukları, bebek arabasını veya alışverişi yanımda götürebilmek

fa.#When choosing how to travel, which fact: هنگام انتخاب روش سفر، کدام عامل‌ها برای شما مهم‌ترند؟
fa.#Mental well-being means how calm or str: منظور از آسایش روانی این است که یک سفر چقدر به شما آرامش یا استرس می‌دهد.
fa.#Reliability and Predictability: قابل اعتماد بودن و قابل پیش‌بینی بودن
fa.#Barrier-free access (no stairs, accessi: دسترسی بدون مانع (بدون پله، وسایل نقلیه دسترس‌پذیر)
fa.#Being able to bring children, a pushcha: امکان همراه بردن کودکان، کالسکه یا خرید

hu.#When choosing how to travel, which fact: Amikor eldönti, hogyan közlekedjen, mely tényezők a legfontosabbak Önnek?
hu.#Mental well-being means how calm or str: A lelki jóllét azt jelenti, mennyire érzi magát nyugodtnak vagy feszültnek egy út során.
hu.#Being able to bring children, a pushcha: Hogy gyermeket, babakocsit vagy bevásárlást is magammal vihessek

ar.#When choosing how to travel, which fact: عند اختيار طريقة التنقل، ما العوامل الأكثر أهمية بالنسبة لك؟
ar.#Mental well-being means how calm or str: يُقصد بالراحة النفسية مدى شعورك بالهدوء أو التوتر خلال الرحلة.
ar.#Barrier-free access (no stairs, accessi: وصول خالٍ من العوائق (بلا درج، مركبات مهيأة)
ar.#Being able to bring children, a pushcha: إمكانية اصطحاب الأطفال أو عربة الأطفال أو المشتريات
